scope: complete Issue8 model-state line only; no communications/scheduling repair
dynamic_model: frozen G2; augmented boundary state E, no theta update

data_roles.M: development masking; dynamics already fit on L+M+S, not held-out validation
data_roles.Y: candidate frozen before new replay; development replay, no physical Ts truth
data_roles.synthetic: known Tf/Ts/E truth; fixed theta and explicit sensor/noise assumptions

prior.origin: Only frozen L/S nuisance entries; never E_M, Ts_M, new-run prefix or YET/ambient
prior.interpretation: broad engineering prior, not measured equilibrium or calibrated probability

numerical.propagation: exact affine matrix exponential on actual irregular dt
numerical.covariance: exact Van Loan discretization; Joseph TJ update; symmetric covariance
numerical.uncertainty: internal assumed-model covariance and 2-standard-deviation scale, NOT a calibrated 95% interval
numerical.posterior_projection: original E/Ts bounds; record unconstrained values and projection, never tracking while projected

input_policy.fan_assumption: last successful fraction held conditionally; startup uses 0.5 with full [0,1] range
input_policy.long_gap: stop public Tf/Ts/E; discard internal state, next fresh TJ/rails cold-start from registered prior
input_policy.source_epoch: reset on raw stream/connection/lifecycle or genuine source-invalid boundary; never task phase
input_policy.explicit_guard_fault_or_nonAUTO: public observer unavailable; raw risk remains visible; never normal
input_policy.stale_normalized_or_binding: degraded, preserve conditional thermal history, no normal/tracking claim
input_policy.HTTP_timeout: observational unknown, conditional propagation without renewing successful PWM

masks.selection: times/event kinds only, never hidden PWM/thermal values or full-M state
masks.M_cluster: copy first 60s Y timeout timing block with >=2 failed fan polls; each exposure [failure-1s,next successful fan), translated to M+300s
masks.M_transition: [-2,+6] seconds around first runner work-block start, from recorded event timing only
masks.projection: replace whole masked fan response by payload=null/offline_mask; no derived full-input quality/state enters observer

evaluation.origins: every valid accepted TJ, not old five-second starts
evaluation.forecast_Tf_anchor: same current real TJ for all methods; filtered Tf reported separately
evaluation.B: HOLD two current rails and known/declared conditional PWM; no future inputs/TJ/end markers
evaluation.A: recorded future two rails and successful PWM within original TTL, no future TJ update; omit when actual future input path unavailable
evaluation.A_contract: R2 physical-input diagnostic, stratify observed context; retain original strict results separately, do not silently rename old scores
evaluation.comparisons: pairwise/common origin+horizon+label refs with cohort SHA; also each method own coverage and all-valid-TJ denominator
evaluation.tails: P95/max positive underprediction; fraction underpredicting >2C is description, not safety threshold
evaluation.real_Ts: difference to separately run unmasked M reference only, never true error
evaluation.surface: not read by new observer/evaluator, no clock fitting or external score

synthetic.truth_solver: independent scipy solve_ivp, no reuse of KF numerical step for truth
synthetic.report: Tf/Ts/E true errors and empirical internal-scale inclusion; not real Ts accuracy

interface.transport: local read-only JSONL, no extra poll/service
interface.field_use: research_only; external surface never enters state

source_rule: all input archives and old outputs immutable; new masks/spec/results only; no commit/push/software PR
